title: Appraiser Standing and Report Standards under Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services
content:
# Standards Note: Appraiser Standing and Report Standards

Under Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services each service fixes the standing an appraiser must hold to sign its report, whether a second appraiser reviews the report before it is signed, and the professional standards the report is prepared to.

| Service | Standing required to sign | Second appraiser review before signing | Prepared to the Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice (USPAP) | Prepared to a standard a court will receive |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Verbal Counter Estimate | Counter trained | No | No | No |
| Insurance Replacement Appraisal | Graduate gemologist | No | Yes | No |
| Fair Market Value Appraisal | Graduate gemologist | No | Yes | Yes |
| Estate and Probate Appraisal | Certified appraiser | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Certified Gemological Laboratory Report | Laboratory graduate gemologist | Yes | No | No |
| Collection Portfolio Appraisal | Master appraiser | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Clauses

1. The standing in the second column is the standing an appraiser must hold to sign a report under that service.
2. Where the third column reads Yes, a second appraiser reviews the report before it is signed; where it reads No, no second review is part of the service.
3. The fourth column records whether the report is prepared to the Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice; the fifth records whether it is prepared to a standard a court will receive.

## Questions answered

**Which services put a second appraiser on the report?** The Estate and Probate Appraisal, the Certified Gemological Laboratory Report and the Collection Portfolio Appraisal.

**Which services are prepared to a standard a court will receive?** The Fair Market Value Appraisal, the Estate and Probate Appraisal and the Collection Portfolio Appraisal. The Insurance Replacement Appraisal is prepared to USPAP but not to a court standard, and the Certified Gemological Laboratory Report is prepared to neither.

**Does a graduate gemologist sign at every service?** No. A graduate gemologist signs the Insurance Replacement Appraisal and the Fair Market Value Appraisal; the other four services each require a different standing.
